name: Real session: UI Designer at Yellow Slice — phrase loop, number swap, ignored confusion, premature close
notes: Imported 2026-05-07. Yellow Slice UI Designer band per AmbitionBox/Indeed: ₹3.8-5.6 LPA. AI opened at ₹7.5 LPA (already inflated), then went into a generation loop repeating 'that's the absolute top of what I can approve' 4 times in one turn, swapped its own offer with the user's target, quoted a reversed range '₹12 to ₹8.5 LPA', and closed the deal after the user said 'why are you confusing me so much'. End-to-end the AI was incoherent.
